svg.title: Attack Simulation: A full attack-simulation workflow, scoped and documented end to end.
svg.desc: Attack Simulation. A full attack-simulation workflow, scoped and documented end to end. Offense: scoping, OSINT, validation, exploitation, post-exploitation. Defense: remediation report mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK kill chain. Tools: PTES, MITRE ATT&CK, OSINT, Risk Report.
